18.1.en: Arjuna: "What's the real difference between renouncing and letting go?" The final chapter begins.
18.1.hi: Arjun: "Sanyas aur tyaag mein asli farak kya hai?" Aakhri chapter shuru.

18.2.en: Renouncing means dropping selfish actions. Letting go means doing your work but dropping the attachment to results.
18.2.hi: Sanyas matlab selfish kaam chhodna. Tyaag matlab kaam karna par result ka attachment chhodna.

18.3.en: Some say quit all action. Others say keep doing good things like charity and discipline.
18.3.hi: Kuch kehte hain sab karm chhodo. Kuch kehte hain daan aur tap jaise achhe kaam karte raho.

18.4.en: Krishna: "Here's my final take. Letting go comes in three types."
18.4.hi: Krishna: "Ye mera final verdict hai. Tyaag teen tarah ka hota hai."

18.5.en: Worship, charity and discipline shouldn't be dropped. They purify even wise people.
18.5.hi: Pooja, daan aur tap chhodne nahi chahiye. Ye gyaaniyon ko bhi shuddh karte hain.

18.6.en: But even these should be done without attachment or expecting results. That's my final answer.
18.6.hi: Par ye bhi bina attachment aur bina result ki umeed ke karne chahiye. Ye mera final answer hai.

18.7.en: Ditching your duties out of confusion? That's the lazy, dark kind of quitting.
18.7.hi: Confusion mein apni duty chhod dena? Ye aalsi, andhere wala tyaag hai.

18.8.en: Quitting because something's hard or uncomfortable? That's the restless kind, and it gets you nothing.
18.8.hi: Kuch mushkil ya uncomfortable hai isliye chhodna? Ye bechain tyaag hai, aur isse kuch nahi milta.

18.9.en: Doing your duty fully while letting go of attachment and results? That's the pure kind.
18.9.hi: Apni duty poori karna, par attachment aur result chhod ke? Ye shuddh tyaag hai.

18.10.en: A truly wise person doesn't avoid unpleasant work or cling to pleasant work. No doubts, just clarity.
18.10.hi: Sachcha gyaani na bura kaam avoid karta hai, na achhe se chipakta hai. Doubt nahi, bas clarity.

18.11.en: You can't stop acting while you have a body. Real letting go means letting go of results.
18.11.hi: Jab tak body hai, karm rok nahi sakte. Asli tyaag matlab result chhodna.

18.12.en: If you cling to results, you get good, bad or mixed karma. Let go and none of it sticks.
18.12.hi: Result se chipko toh achha, bura ya mixed karma milta hai. Chhod do toh kuch nahi chipakta.

18.13.en: Every action has five causes. Let me break them down.
18.13.hi: Har karm ke paanch kaaran hote hain. Chalo breakdown karta hoon.

18.14.en: The body, the doer, the senses, the various efforts, and divine will. Five factors behind every action.
18.14.hi: Body, karne wala, senses, alag-alag koshishein, aur divine ichchha. Har karm ke peeche paanch factors.

18.15.en: Whatever you do with body, words or mind, right or wrong, these five are behind it.
18.15.hi: Body, shabd ya mann se jo bhi karo, sahi ya galat, ye paanch uske peeche hain.

18.16.en: So thinking "I alone did this" is a limited view. You're only one of five factors.
18.16.hi: Toh sochna ki "sab maine akele kiya" chhoti soch hai. Tum paanch mein se bas ek factor ho.

18.17.en: Someone with no "I did it" ego and a clean mind isn't bound by their actions.
18.17.hi: Jisme "maine kiya" wala ego nahi aur mann saaf hai, woh apne karm se bandhta nahi.

18.18.en: Knowledge, the thing known and the knower drive action. The tool, the act and the doer make it happen.
18.18.hi: Gyaan, jaanne layak cheez aur jaanne wala karm ko chalate hain. Saadhan, kaam aur karta use poora karte hain.

18.19.en: Knowledge, action and the doer each come in three types too. Here's how.
18.19.hi: Gyaan, karm aur karta bhi teen-teen tarah ke hote hain. Aise.

18.20.en: Pure knowledge sees one unchanging reality in all beings. Unity in diversity.
18.20.hi: Shuddh gyaan sab jeevon mein ek hi atal sach dekhta hai. Anekta mein ekta.

18.21.en: Passionate knowledge sees everyone as totally separate and different. Us versus them.
18.21.hi: Rajasi gyaan sabko bilkul alag-alag dekhta hai. Hum versus woh.

18.22.en: Dark knowledge fixates on one small thing as if it's everything. Narrow, illogical, shallow.
18.22.hi: Tamasi gyaan ek chhoti cheez ko hi sab kuch maan leta hai. Tang, bina tark, khokhla.

18.23.en: Pure action: doing what's needed, without attachment, likes or dislikes, or wanting rewards.
18.23.hi: Shuddh karm: jo zaroori hai woh karna, bina attachment, pasand-naapasand ya reward ki chahat.

18.24.en: Passionate action: lots of stress and effort, all to satisfy your ego and desires.
18.24.hi: Rajasi karm: bahut stress aur mehnat, sab ego aur chahat poori karne ke liye.

18.25.en: Dark action: done blindly, ignoring consequences, harm to others, and your own limits.
18.25.hi: Tamasi karm: andhadhundh, nateeje, dusron ka nuksaan aur apni limits ignore karke.

18.26.en: A pure doer: no attachment, no bragging, steady, enthusiastic, unbothered by success or failure.
18.26.hi: Shuddh karta: na attachment, na shekhi, steady, utsaahi, success ya failure se unbothered.

18.27.en: A passionate doer: attached, result-obsessed, greedy, harmful, and on an emotional rollercoaster.
18.27.hi: Rajasi karta: attached, result ka obsessed, laalchi, nuksaandeh, aur emotional rollercoaster pe.

18.28.en: A dark doer: careless, stubborn, dishonest, lazy, gloomy and always procrastinating.
18.28.hi: Tamasi karta: laparwah, ziddi, beimaan, aalsi, udaas aur hamesha taalne wala.

18.29.en: Now the three types of intellect and willpower.
18.29.hi: Ab buddhi aur dhairya ke teen prakaar.

18.30.en: Pure intellect knows what to do and avoid, when to fear and when not, what binds and what frees.
18.30.hi: Shuddh buddhi jaanti hai kya karna aur kya nahi, kab darna aur kab nahi, kya baandhta aur kya free karta.

18.31.en: Passionate intellect gets confused between right and wrong, what to do and what not to do.
18.31.hi: Rajasi buddhi sahi-galat, karna-na karna mein confuse ho jaati hai.

18.32.en: Dark intellect sees wrong as right and flips every value upside down.
18.32.hi: Tamasi buddhi galat ko sahi dekhti hai aur har value ulti kar deti hai.

18.33.en: Pure willpower keeps your mind, breath and senses steady through practice. Unshakeable focus.
18.33.hi: Shuddh dhairya practice se mind, saans aur senses steady rakhta hai. Atal focus.

18.34.en: Passionate willpower holds tight to duty, desire and wealth, but only for what you'll get out of it.
18.34.hi: Rajasi dhairya duty, chahat aur paise ko pakad ke rakhta hai, par sirf apne fayde ke liye.

18.35.en: Dark willpower is just being stubborn about not giving up sleep, fear, sadness and ego.
18.35.hi: Tamasi dhairya bas neend, darr, udaasi aur ego na chhodne ki zid hai.

18.36.en: Now the three kinds of happiness. Real joy builds with practice and ends your pain.
18.36.hi: Ab khushi ke teen prakaar. Asli khushi practice se banti hai aur dukh khatam karti hai.

18.37.en: Pure happiness feels like medicine at first but becomes nectar. It comes from a calm, clear mind.
18.37.hi: Shuddh khushi pehle dawai jaisi kadwi lagti hai par baad mein amrit. Shaant, saaf mann se aati hai.

18.38.en: Passionate happiness feels like nectar at first but turns into poison. Instant gratification, long-term regret.
18.38.hi: Rajasi khushi pehle amrit jaisi lagti hai par baad mein zehar. Instant maza, baad mein pachhtava.

18.39.en: Dark happiness comes from oversleeping, laziness and carelessness. It fools you from start to finish.
18.39.hi: Tamasi khushi zyada neend, aalas aur laparwahi se aati hai. Shuru se ant tak dhokha deti hai.

18.40.en: No one, on earth or in heaven, is free from these three energies.
18.40.hi: Dharti ya swarg mein koi bhi in teen energies se free nahi hai.

18.41.en: People's roles in society are meant to match their natural qualities, not their birth.
18.41.hi: Samaaj mein logon ka role unki natural qualities se match hona chahiye, janam se nahi.

18.42.en: Thinkers and teachers by nature: calm, disciplined, pure, patient, honest, wise and full of faith.
18.42.hi: Nature se sochne aur sikhane wale: shaant, disciplined, shuddh, sabr wale, imaandaar, gyaani aur bharose wale.

18.43.en: Leaders and protectors by nature: brave, energetic, steady, skilled, generous and never running from a fight.
18.43.hi: Nature se leader aur rakshak: bahadur, energetic, steady, skilled, daani aur ladai se kabhi na bhaagne wale.

18.44.en: Builders, farmers and traders by nature create wealth. Those who love serving keep everything running.
18.44.hi: Nature se banane wale, kisaan aur vyapaari daulat banate hain. Seva pasand log sab chalate rehte hain.

18.45.en: Dedicate yourself to your own natural work and you reach perfection. Here's how.
18.45.hi: Apne natural kaam mein dil lagao aur perfection tak pahunchoge. Aise.

18.46.en: Do your own work as worship of the one who created everything, and you'll reach perfection.
18.46.hi: Apna kaam us rachnakar ki pooja samajh ke karo jisne sab banaya, aur perfection paoge.

18.47.en: Your own path done imperfectly beats someone else's done perfectly. Doing your own thing keeps you clean.
18.47.hi: Apna raasta imperfect bhi better hai kisi aur ke perfect se. Apna kaam karna tumhe saaf rakhta hai.

18.48.en: Don't quit your work just because it's imperfect. Every effort has some flaw, like fire has smoke.
18.48.hi: Kaam imperfect hai isliye mat chhodo. Har koshish mein kuch kami hoti hai, jaise aag mein dhuaan.

18.49.en: Unattached, self-controlled, free from craving. Through letting go, you reach the ultimate freedom.
18.49.hi: Bina attachment, self-controlled, craving se free. Chhodne se tum param freedom paate ho.

18.50.en: Here's the short version of how a perfected person reaches the ultimate.
18.50.hi: Ye raha short version ki perfect insaan ultimate tak kaise pahunchta hai.

18.51.en: A clear mind, steady self-control, stepping back from distractions, and dropping love-hate drama.
18.51.hi: Saaf mann, steady self-control, distractions se door, aur pasand-naapasand ka drama khatam.

18.52.en: Enjoying solitude, eating light, controlling body, speech and mind, meditating, staying detached.
18.52.hi: Akelapan enjoy karna, halka khaana, body, vaani aur mann pe control, dhyaan, detached rehna.

18.53.en: Dropping ego, power trips, pride, lust, anger and hoarding. No "mine". Total peace.
18.53.hi: Ego, power trips, ghamand, vaasna, gussa aur jama karna chhodna. "Mera" kuch nahi. Poori shaanti.

18.54.en: At peace, without grief or craving, seeing everyone as equal, you find the highest love for me.
18.54.hi: Shaant, na dukh na craving, sabko barabar dekhte hue, tum mere liye sabse ooncha pyaar paate ho.

18.55.en: Through that love you truly know who I am. And knowing me, you become one with me.
18.55.hi: Us pyaar se tum sach mein jaante ho main kaun hoon. Aur mujhe jaan ke mujhse ek ho jaate ho.

18.56.en: Keep doing your work while trusting me, and by my grace you reach the eternal home.
18.56.hi: Mujh pe bharosa rakh ke kaam karte raho, aur meri kripa se amar ghar paoge.

18.57.en: Mentally hand over all your actions to me, make me your goal, and keep your thoughts on me.
18.57.hi: Mann se apne saare karm mujhe saunp do, mujhe goal banao, aur khayal mujh pe rakho.

18.58.en: Keep me in mind and you'll get through every obstacle. Ignore me out of ego and you'll struggle.
18.58.hi: Mujhe yaad rakho toh har mushkil paar karoge. Ego mein ignore karoge toh struggle karoge.

18.59.en: "I won't fight"? Your ego is talking. Your own nature will push you to act anyway.
18.59.hi: "Main nahi ladunga"? Ye tumhara ego bol raha hai. Tumhari nature tumse karwa hi legi.

18.60.en: What you refuse to do out of confusion, your nature will make you do anyway.
18.60.hi: Jo confusion mein karne se mana kar rahe ho, tumhari nature waise bhi karwa degi.

18.61.en: The divine lives in every heart and moves all beings, like riders on a wheel.
18.61.hi: Divine har dil mein rehta hai aur sab jeevon ko chalata hai, jaise chakkar pe baithe log.

18.62.en: Turn to the divine with everything you've got. By that grace you'll find supreme peace.
18.62.hi: Poori jaan se divine ki sharan lo. Us kripa se param shaanti milegi.

18.63.en: That's the deepest wisdom. Think it through fully, then do what you choose. Your call.
18.63.hi: Ye sabse gehra gyaan hai. Poora soch lo, phir jo chaho karo. Tumhari choice.

18.64.en: "Listen to my most secret message once more. I'm telling you because I care about you deeply."
18.64.hi: "Mera sabse secret message ek baar aur suno. Bata raha hoon kyunki tumhari bahut parwaah hai."

18.65.en: Keep your mind on me, love me, honour me, bow to me. You'll come to me. That's my promise.
18.65.hi: Mind mujh pe rakho, pyaar karo, izzat do, jhuko. Mere paas aaoge. Ye mera vaada hai.

18.66.en: Drop the pressure and overthinking. Trust me completely and I've got you. Don't stress.
18.66.hi: Saara pressure aur overthinking chhodo. Mujh par poora bharosa rakho, main hoon na. Tension mat lo.

18.67.en: Don't force this on people who aren't interested, aren't disciplined, or mock it.
18.67.hi: Ye un logon pe mat thopo jo interested nahi, disciplined nahi, ya mazaak udaate hain.

18.68.en: Whoever shares this wisdom with sincere seekers will surely come to me.
18.68.hi: Jo ye gyaan sachche seekers ke saath share karega, woh zaroor mere paas aayega.

18.69.en: No one does anything dearer to me than that. Nobody will be dearer to me.
18.69.hi: Isse zyada pyaara kaam mere liye koi nahi karta. Koi mujhe isse zyada pyaara nahi hoga.

18.70.en: Even studying this conversation counts as worshipping me through knowledge.
18.70.hi: Is baat-cheet ko padhna bhi gyaan se meri pooja maana jaayega.

18.71.en: And just listening with faith, without picking holes, sets you free too.
18.71.hi: Aur bas bharose se sunna, bina nukta-cheeni ke, bhi tumhe free karta hai.

18.72.en: "Arjuna, did you really listen? Is your confusion gone?" The ultimate check-in.
18.72.hi: "Arjun, kya tumne sach mein suna? Confusion gaya?" Ultimate check-in.

18.73.en: Arjuna: "My confusion is gone. I remember who I am. No doubts left. I'll do what you say." Glow-up complete.
18.73.hi: Arjun: "Mera confusion chala gaya. Mujhe yaad aa gaya main kaun hoon. Koi doubt nahi. Jo aap kahoge karunga." Glow-up complete.

18.74.en: Sanjaya: "I heard this amazing conversation between Krishna and Arjuna. Goosebumps."
18.74.hi: Sanjay: "Maine Krishna aur Arjun ki ye adbhut baat suni. Rongte khade ho gaye."

18.75.en: "Thanks to Vyasa, I heard this highest wisdom straight from Krishna himself."
18.75.hi: "Vyas ji ki kripa se maine ye param gyaan seedha Krishna se suna."

18.76.en: "Every time I remember this conversation, I feel joy all over again."
18.76.hi: "Jab bhi ye baat-cheet yaad aati hai, phir se khushi hoti hai."

18.77.en: "And remembering that cosmic form of Krishna, I'm amazed again and again."
18.77.hi: "Aur Krishna ka woh vishwaroop yaad karke baar-baar hairaan hota hoon."

18.78.en: Wherever Krishna's wisdom and Arjuna's action meet, there's success, prosperity and doing what's right. Final word.
18.78.hi: Jahan Krishna ka gyaan aur Arjun ka karm milte hain, wahan jeet, samriddhi aur dharm hota hai. Aakhri baat.
